notes.text: The checked passage reads Rav Se’uram, brother of Rava, directly.

The end-of-tractate story uses the She’orim form. Rava asks his brother to convey the plea; his brother questions the premise and asks for a later appearance. Rava later describes the pain as like the prick of a bloodletting implement.
Heilprin compresses the exchange. The Bavli has Rava request the intercession and does not explicitly narrate the brother carrying it out.

The two checked Bavli passages establish the brother of Rava, not this next generation. Heilprin’s Rav Safra heading has an ambiguous parallel with Se’udam; preserve the stated son and the separate unresolved attachment.
